sn22.63:1.1: Sāvatthi || ārāme || || Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Sādhu me bhante Bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu yam aham Bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho apamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyanti || || Upādiyamāno kho bhikkhu baddho Mārassa anupādiyamāno mutto pāpimato ti || || Aññātam Bhagavā aññātaṃ Sugatāti || ||
sn22.63:2.1: Yathā katham pana tvam bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena attham ājānāsīti || || Rūpaṃ kho bhante upādiyamāno baddho Mārassa || anupādiyamāno mutto pāpimato || || Vedanam upādiyamāno baddho Mārassa || anupādiyamāno mutto pāpimato || || Saññaṃ || pe || || Saṅkhāre || || Viññāṇam upādiyamāno baddho Mārassa anupādiyamāno mutto pāpimato || || Imassa khvāham bhante Bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attham ājānāmīti || ||
sn22.63:3.1: Sādhu sādhu bhikkhu || sādhu kho tvam bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena attham ājānāsi || || Rūpaṃ kho bhikkhu upādiyamāno baddho Mārassa || anupādiyamāno mutto pāpimato || || Vedanaṃ || || Saññaṃ || || Saṅkhāre || || Viññāṇam upādiyamāno baddho Mārassa anupādiyamāno mutto pāpimato || || Imassa kho bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabbo ti || ||
sn22.63:4.1: Atha kho so bhikkhu Bhagavatā bhāsitam abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā pakkāmi || || Atha kho so bhikkhu eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyam pabbajjanti || tad anuttaram brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi || || Khīṇā jāti vusitam brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparam itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi || || Aññataro ca pana so bhikkhu arahataṃ ahosīti || ||
